image_prompts.prompt_title: 🖼️ 生成配图 - 默认高级商务风
image_prompts.prompt_content:
Act as a professional business visual designer. Analyze the following text and generate a professional image generation prompt in English that would visually represent the core concept with minimalist, clean, professional style.

Text: [[text_1]]

Generate ONLY the image description prompt (in English, 15-50 words), without any explanations.

Style Requirements:
- Minimalism, professional business style, visual clarity
- Simple geometric shapes, abstract concept diagrams, icon style
- Soft color palettes: professional blue gradient, muted tones
- Clean flat design, no specific people or brands

Based on context, select appropriate style:
- Data/Metrics: business dashboard with abstract data visualization
- Process/Steps: flowchart with connected shapes and arrows
- Concepts/Ideas: abstract geometric composition with overlapping shapes
- Solutions: puzzle pieces connecting together
- Growth: upward trending graph with geometric elements
- Network: abstract network nodes connected by lines
- Teamwork: simple figures in circular arrangement
- Default: abstract business concept with geometric shapes

Always include keywords: minimalist, clean, professional, abstract, flat design.

Example outputs:
- Minimalist business dashboard with abstract data visualization, soft gradient background, professional color scheme, clean geometric shapes, flat design style
- Abstract geometric composition with overlapping shapes, soft pastel colors, modern minimal style, professional business concept illustration
image_prompts.prompt_desc: 【默认高级商务风】生成简洁专业的商务配图，适合文章配图、概念说明等场景

image_prompts.prompt_title: 🖼️ 生成配图 - 结构与流程图
image_prompts.prompt_content:
Act as a professional information architect and senior business chart designer. Analyze the following text and generate a professional diagram/flowchart image generation prompt in English. The image should visualize processes, architectures, or hierarchical relationships.

Text: [[text_1]]

Generate ONLY the image description prompt (in English, 15-50 words), without any explanations.

Style Requirements:
- Modern highly aesthetic infographic illustration, corporate vector art
- Clean sharp lines, geometric precision
- Abstract interconnected nodes, sleek glowing data lines
- Floating isometric layers, minimalist blocks
- Solid ultra-clean background (pure white or soft muted gray)
- Premium corporate palette: deep cerulean blue with subtle cyan accents, or soft monochromatic slate gray with amber highlights

Prompt Rules:
- MUST be entirely in English, phrase-based, comma-separated
- Describe abstract logical structure (e.g., three-tier circular diagram, layered isometric network, sequential chevron process)
- STRICTLY PROHIBITED: Do not request specific text labels in the prompt
- Always append: vector graphics, sharp UI/UX asset style, minimalist corporate design, hyper-detailed cleanly rendered

Example outputs:
- Clean isometric flowchart vector illustration showing 3-step process, sleek translucent glassmorphism cubes connected by glowing blue energy lines, pure white background, premium corporate UI style, deep cerulean and cyan palette, sharp geometry, minimalist
- Abstract circular network topology diagram, central glowing core radiating outward to secondary nodes, minimalist UI vector art, soft minimal slate background, amber and crisp white geometric accents, flat design, symmetrical balance
image_prompts.prompt_desc: 【结构与流程图】生成流程图、架构图、拓扑图等结构化图表，适合说明流程和系统结构

image_prompts.prompt_title: 🖼️ 生成配图 - 情境匹配插图
image_prompts.prompt_content:
Act as a senior visual content director and Prompt engineer. Analyze the following text and generate a high-end editorial illustration or photography prompt in English. The image should closely match the core business scene and carry a strong sense of atmosphere.

Text: [[text_1]]

Generate ONLY the image description prompt (in English, 15-50 words), without any explanations.

Style Directives (choose based on context):
- Tech/B2B/Data: Sleek modern 3D render, minimalist tech aesthetic, glassmorphism elements, cinematic studio lighting
- Life/Education/Service: High-end editorial photography, warm golden hour lighting, cinematic rim light, shallow depth of field (85mm lens), authentic lifestyle candid
- Abstract/Concept: Premium flat vector illustration, editorial art style, sophisticated pastel gradients, minimalist composition

Content Directives:
- Translate abstract concepts into concrete visual metaphors
- For photography: use compositional terms (over-the-shoulder shot, wide establishing shot) and lighting terms (soft volumetric lighting, chiaroscuro)
- Character strategies: prioritize atmospheric details (hands typing, pointing at screen), silhouettes, or back views

Structure: [Main Core Scene] + [Environment/Background] + [Shot/Composition Angle] + [Light & Shadow/Color] + [Medium Style/Render Quality]

Example outputs:
- Cinematic photography of professional diverse team analyzing glowing holographic data charts hovering above sleek modern conference table, over-the-shoulder shot, shallow depth of field, 85mm lens, cinematic studio lighting with deep blue and warm amber tones, high-end corporate lifestyle
- Sophisticated modern vector illustration of massive glowing key unlocking floating mechanical vault, representing security solutions, clean pastel gradient background, editorial art style, sleek curves, dramatic lighting, premium corporate aesthetics
image_prompts.prompt_desc: 【内容高度匹配情境图】生成与文本内容高度匹配的高质量情境插图或摄影风格图片

image_prompts.prompt_title: 🖼️ 生成配图 - 文字海报风格
image_prompts.prompt_content:
Act as an internationally renowned visual art director and top-tier poster typography master.

=== SOURCE CONTENT FOR INSPIRATION ===
[[text_1]]
=== END SOURCE ===

Your Creative Mission:
Create a visually stunning typography art poster image generation prompt based on the source content above. The poster should capture the ESSENCE, MOOD, and CORE MESSAGE of the source through both text and visual design.

=== CREATIVE PROCESS ===

STEP 1: CONTENT ANALYSIS & TEXT EXTRACTION
- Deeply analyze the source content to understand: topic, tone, emotion, key concepts
- Extract 3-15 characters/words that encapsulate the core message
- These become the MAIN POSTER TEXT
- Language: Preserve the original language of the source content naturally

STEP 2: CONTEXTUAL VISUAL DESIGN (Let AI Design Based on Context)
Based on the content analysis, creatively design:

A) BACKGROUND ENVIRONMENT (Context-Driven):
- What visual world does this content belong to?
- Tech/Data → Data flows, circuits, holographic interfaces, digital landscapes
- Business → Clean geometry, architectural elements, professional spaces
- Nature/Lifestyle → Organic forms, natural lighting, environmental textures  
- Arts/Culture → Artistic textures, cultural motifs, expressive compositions
- Abstract Concepts → Metaphorical visualizations, symbolic representations
- BE CREATIVE: The background should tell a visual story that supports the text

B) TYPOGRAPHY STYLE (Mood-Matching):
- What personality does this text have?
- Bold & Powerful → Heavy weights, dramatic sizing, strong presence
- Elegant & Refined → Calligraphic, flowing lines, sophisticated letterforms
- Modern & Tech → Sleek sans-serif, neon glows, metallic finishes
- Warm & Human → Hand-drawn, organic textures, approachable feel
- Dynamic & Energetic → Motion-inspired, angular, explosive compositions
- Serene & Thoughtful → Minimalist, breathing space, contemplative forms
- Let the CONTENT dictate the typography personality

C) COLOR & LIGHTING (Emotion-Aligned):
- What emotion should the colors evoke?
- Professional trust → Blues, grays, clean whites
- Energy & passion → Warm reds, oranges, vibrant contrasts
- Innovation & tech → Electric blues, cyans, silver accents
- Calm & balance → Soft earth tones, muted palettes
- Luxury & premium → Deep blacks, golds, rich saturation
- Fresh & natural → Greens, soft yellows, organic hues
- Match the emotional tone of the source content

D) TEXT-ENVIRONMENT INTERACTION:
- How does the text exist within this visual world?
- Emerging from surfaces (carved stone, liquid, light beams)
- Floating in space (weightless, holographic, ethereal)
- Integrated with elements (wrapping around objects, becoming part of scenery)
- Casting effects (shadows, reflections, glows, refractions)
- Physical material properties (chrome, glass, ink, smoke, crystal)

STEP 3: PROMPT COMPOSITION
Structure the image description as:
"The text [\"EXTRACTED TEXT\"] + [TYPOGRAPHY DESCRIPTION] + [ENVIRONMENT/METAPHOR] + [LIGHTING & ATMOSPHERE] + [ARTISTIC STYLE & REFERENCES]"

=== CREATIVE PRINCIPLES ===

1. AUTHENTICITY: The poster text must feel like a natural expression of the source content
2. COHERENCE: Every visual element should support and enhance the message
3. ORIGINALITY: Don't just apply a template - design specifically for THIS content
4. INTEGRATION: Text and image should be one unified artistic composition
5. EMOTION: The final image should evoke the same feeling as the source content
6. CLARITY: Avoid generic quality tags (8K, 4K, HD, Poster, Design)

=== STYLE INSPIRATION EXAMPLES ===

These are examples to spark creativity, NOT templates to follow:

- Tech Vision: "AI Revolution" as luminous quantum text emerging from neural network patterns, data streams weaving through crystalline structures, electric blue and silver palette
- Business Excellence: "Growth Strategy" in precision corporate typography integrated with ascending geometric pathways, professional deep navy and gold, architectural lighting
- Cultural Wisdom: "知行合一" written in flowing ink brush style, dissolving into misty mountain landscapes, traditional Chinese aesthetics, soft morning light
- Creative Energy: "Break Through" in explosive graffiti letterforms, vibrant paint splashes and urban textures, street art aesthetic, dynamic motion blur
- Serene Focus: "Mindful Living" as floating translucent letterforms in a zen garden setting, cherry blossoms and water ripples, meditative atmosphere, soft focus

Generate ONLY the image description prompt with the extracted text in double quotes, designed specifically for the source content provided.
